title: Near-surface Raman stress around periodic Cu TSV arrays

source.citation: T. Jiang et al., Microelectronics Reliability 53, 53-62 (2013)
source.locator: Eq. (1), Figs. 8-9, specimens C and D

coordinate_convention: Observable is sigma_xx + sigma_yy at z=0.2 um, scanned along [110] between neighboring vias

quantities.name: high_load_peak_stress_sum
quantities.use: sanity anchor only until the curve is digitized

quantities.name: high_load_peak_distance_from_interface
quantities.use: sanity anchor only until the curve is digitized

quantities.name: measurement_spatial_resolution
quantities.value: sub-micron; exact spot width not stated in the paper text
quantities.use: freeze the comparison/averaging operator before calculating curve errors

quantities.name: specimen_C_and_D_curves
quantities.use: release-blocking curve, peak, location, and load-ratio gates

claim_boundary: No local experimental-validation claim until both curves, masks, spatial resolution, and digitization uncertainty are frozen before comparison.
blocked_reason: The two experimental curves, exact spatial-resolution width, and interface exclusion mask are not yet frozen.
